name: IBY_XCC_EXTRACT
description: Stores the information which is needed for budget control flow

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated by Budgetary Control for every budget control call.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_1
columns.description: Stores the identifier of the payment which needs to be budget controlled. Value is same as the PAYMENT_ID column of the IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL table.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_2
columns.description: This column is currently unused.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates the transaction number.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_1
columns.description: Stores the payment ID of the payment which needs to be budget controlled.  Same as the Payment_ID of the IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL table.  Same as SOURCE_HEADER_ID_1.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_2
columns.description: Stores the invoice identifier of the payment which needs to be budget controlled. Value is same as the INVOICE_ID column of the AP_INVOICES_ALL table.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_3
columns.description: Code combination identifier derived by overlaying the account segment of the cash account to the expense account.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_4
columns.description: This column is currently unused.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_5
columns.description: This column is currently unused.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_ID_6
columns.description: This column is currently unused.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Code used to control the order in which budget lines are processed.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary ledger of the transaction or distribution. Required when an associated ledger is available for the transaction or distribution.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit that owns the transaction or distribution. Required when an associated business unit is available for the transaction or distribution.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment subtype code. Used to allow enablement at a level lower than the transaction.

columns.name: BUDGET_DATE
columns.description: Date used for reserving funds for this distribution by budgetary control.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date used for accounting this distribution.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY
columns.description: This column stores the payment currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_AMOUNT
columns.description: This column stores the payment amount.

columns.name: BUDGET_CODE_CONCAT_SEGS
columns.description: New concatenated account segment derived by overlaying the account segment of the cash account to the expense account. Used to generate the code combination identifier if it's not already present.

columns.name: CASH_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Cash account code combination identifier for the bank account used during payment.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Unique expense account code combination identifier of the invoice being paid.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Payment process request or quick payment request identifier.

columns.name: CALL_APP_PAY_SERVICE_REQ_CODE
columns.description: Payment process request or quick payment request code.
